julia: Quick QBR item: NexusHW co-launch — propose a gated shift of MDF into marketplace listing credits. Need a partner-health snapshot + impact calc by Thu.
omar: I can do the health snapshot (usage, leads, marketplace vs direct). ETA Thu EOD. Send the partner CSV pls.
kevin: Uploaded partner CSV -> https://redwood.internal/partners/nexushw (view). Note: two pilot agreements reserve credits.
rachel: Finance note: pilots reserve 35k total. Co-marketing pool available: ~140k. We can reassign up to 55k without contract changes.
julia: Target recommendation for Monday: move up to 30% of the co-marketing pool to marketplace credits with per-partner caps and a 60-day conversion review. Need a one-liner rationale for the QBR.
omar: Early signal: reseller-driven deals are slower to convert when listing isn't boosted. I'll add conversion cohorts to the sheet and flag missing enablement assets.
kevin: Ops ask: if we increase marketplace credits, require a safety throttle. Proposal: per-partner daily cap = 1.5k credits, global monthly cap = 50k for NexusHW group.
matt-bot: Reminder: QBR packet due 2024-05-07T17:00Z. Upload to /drive/partnerships/qbrs/NexusHW/
finance: If approved, accounting will need a PO change and separate line items: marketplace_credits vs co-marketing_MDF.
julia: Action owners: @omar metrics + partner audit, @kevin guardrails + policy wording, @rachel finance readiness, @julia draft one-line rationale and contingency plan. Flag if timing is an issue.
omar: I'll post audit highlights by Thu EOD.
kevin: Guardrail draft by Fri AM. Includes automation to pause credit grants if conversion < 8% after 30 days.
rachel: Will prep PO change template and cost impact estimate.
julia: Thanks 44d we'll sync 15m Friday after the uploads. Calendar invite incoming.
